card.name: Middle digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, where another digit still follows. It appears in temperatures, percentage ranges, doses, and reference numbers.

modes.label: Temperatures and ranges
modes.description: A digit inside a temperature or numeric range, often before a degree sign or closing bracket.

modes.label: Percent and dose figures
modes.description: A digit inside a percentage, dose, or lab range value, before a final digit like 0.

modes.label: Names and codes
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric code or product name.

card.writes: It favors closing parentheses and brackets and suppresses further digits, which suggests the number is nearly finished.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, just before the last digit that finishes it.
